title: Rezoning map change for 100-12 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills
summary: This application would amend the zoning map in Forest Hills, Queens to allow a 21-story mixed-use building with about 280,800 square feet of floor area, including roughly 389 apartments, 97 of them income-restricted, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on the proposal on October 6, 2026.
